# West FW Living — dallastowers.com
> The independent field guide to renting and buying on Fort Worth's west side (Willow Park, Hudson Oaks, Aledo, Weatherford, Benbrook, White Settlement). Publisher-mode: no brokerage services offered; every figure dated and sourced; Equal Housing Opportunity. Last full build: 2026-07-31. 200 indexed pages.

## Core engines
- /specials — monthly verified concession sweep (6–8 weeks free tracked with fine print)
- /deals — Best Deals ranked by net-effective math · /rent-report/ — observed rents + Concession Index
- /builder-report/2026-08 — Builder Incentive Index · /buy/rent-vs-buy — the engine on our own data
- /tools/ — calculators · /quiz — the match quiz · /data/ — tax table, utilities, internet, true-rent CSV

## Buying
- /buy/ — the buyer's guide hub: process, option period (/buy/inspection-option-period), taxes (/buy/property-taxes-for-buyers), new-vs-resale, first-time, schools-by-district files (/buy/schools/)
- /buy/new-construction/ — the pipeline by community with incentives

## Relocation (origin-market series)
- /relocate/ — hub with the where-are-you-moving-from grid
- /relocate/from-california, from-washington, from-colorado, from-florida, from-hawaii, from-chicago, from-new-york, international — each computes real tax deltas with current brackets (CA 13.3% top; WA CGT + 2028 high-earner tax; CO 4.4% flat; FL insurance honesty; HI 11%→13% path + Act 46; IL 4.95% + Cook parity; NY+NYC 14.776% combined), honestly netted against TX property tax and insurance.
- Español: /es/relocate/ and /es/relocate/international (hreflang-paired)
